parsed.notes:
The fit section defaults to required; BONUS POINTS FOR makes its items optional. Responsibilities and company-description technologies are excluded.
The LLM-building bullet accepts eagerness instead of experience, so its skills are nice_to_have; agents, evaluation, and LLMs also have optional bonus mentions.
The programming-language alternatives are each labeled as named skills, without implying that proficiency in all five is necessary.
Generic developer tools are not assumed to be AI developer tools. Internal automation is mapped literally to workflow automation.
Security exposure is mapped to cybersecurity. Software supply chain security and its named aspects are retained together as an unmapped specialty rather than inventing narrower taxonomy IDs.
The degree label uses the highest named level, master, although a bachelor's degree also qualifies. No German-language requirement is stated.
